subject: Urgent: BrightScape regional latency storm — request to initiate cross-region cutover
messages:
From: Claire Moreno <ops@brightscape.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed 5xx and severe latency hitting our checkout (region: us-west-1)

Dylan,

We started seeing a ramp in 5xx errors at ~07:45 PT and the checkout latency has spiked to 3–6s p95 for the last 40 minutes. This is killing conversion — traffic is coming from our CDN, but traces point to your inference endpoints in us-west-1. Attached a snippet of CloudFront traces and a CSV of sample request timings.

Can we get an immediate mitigation plan? If you need us to cut traffic to a different region for the next 2–4 hours we can accommodate, but we need clear timing and any session/consistency implications. Also please share what mitigations will preserve request ordering for our streaming calls.

—Claire
Claire Moreno
Head of Platform, BrightScape Inc.
ops@brightscape.com

Attachments: perf_log_20280918.csv, latency_dashboard_090818.png

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Claire Moreno <ops@brightscape.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T08:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed 5xx and severe latency hitting our checkout (region: us-west-1)

Claire — thanks for the data. I’m escalating to our on-call infra and routing leads. We see correlated error counts and token-level latency rising in our us-west-1 fleet starting ~07:40 PT.

Immediate plan: 1) triage live metrics and logs, 2) if we can’t stabilize within 30m, request approval to initiate a controlled traffic cutover to us-west-2 for BrightScape (we can maintain session affinity via our sticky-routing mode), 3) keep you informed every 15 minutes.

Can you confirm whether you can accept routing to us-west-2 (same contiguous region group) temporarily? Any DB affinity constraints for streaming calls?

I’ll loop in Rishi and Marissa for rapid remediation and authorization.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed 5xx and severe latency hitting our checkout (region: us-west-1)

On it. Quick summary from infra telemetry: several serving nodes in us-west-1 show slow kernel time in the quantized execution path and KV cache thrashing for long-sequence requests. Error budget alarms have tripped for BrightScape.

Requesting authorization to: 1) failover BrightScape traffic from us-west-1 -> us-west-2 (gradual 20% steps over 10m) using sticky-routing, 2) spin a hot standby with increased batching disabled for their workload to reduce tail latency, 3) enable fallback smaller model variant for low-confidence tokens if latency still elevated after failover.

Estimated user-visible window: ~15–45m for staged cutover. I need approval from Marissa (commercial/exec) for the transient cross-region change and potential SLA credit if we miss the 30m target. Also tagging Soojin for routing config. Attaching quick cutover checklist.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Runtime Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-cutover-plan.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T08:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed 5xx and severe latency hitting our checkout (region: us-west-1)

Approve the staged cutover. Authorize up to 40% traffic diversion to us-west-2 immediately if Rishi believes it will reduce customer impact faster. We should prioritize a minimal state-loss approach: sticky-routing + KV sync where possible. If the cutover exceeds 90 minutes total time or results in >1% sustained error delta, approve a discretionary one-off customer credit (work with Finance on amount).

Dylan — please brief Claire on expected timeline and session implications. Soojin, coordinate the routing change and monitoring escalation.

—Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed 5xx and severe latency hitting our checkout (region: us-west-1)

Triage notes and immediate actions I’m running now: 
- Start staged traffic diverts: us-west-1 -> us-west-2 in 20% increments (10m hold between steps).
- Disable large-batch path for BrightScape routing profile to avoid KV cache thrash.
- Spin hot standby in us-west-2 with lower batch size and increased instance count (estimated +25% compute).
- Retain sticky-routing cookie TTL to preserve session ordering.

I’ll post play-by-play to this thread and push updates to the BrightScape shared drive. If we see error decrease <50% after first 20% step, we accelerate the ramp.

—Soojin Lee
Routing & Capacity Lead, Redwood Inference

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Claire Moreno <ops@brightscape.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed 5xx and severe latency hitting our checkout (region: us-west-1)

Claire — we are initiating a staged cutover to us-west-2 now under Marissa's approval. Summary of customer impact / what to expect: 
- 0–10m: first 20% of BrightScape traffic shifted. Expect minor variance in response timings as sessions rehydrate.
- Sticky-routing preserved for active sessions (TTL-based); streaming calls should continue but may see a short tail re-establish window (~5–15s) if connection routes to new nodes.
- We disabled the large-batch execution path for your profile to reduce tail-latency.

We’ll update every 10 minutes and share a post-mortem when stable. Please confirm you’re ok with this action and whether your side needs a different region (apac/eu) instead for regulatory reasons.

—Dylan

From: Claire Moreno <ops@brightscape.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-19T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observed 5xx and severe latency hitting our checkout (region: us-west-1)

Team — thank you. After the staged ramp to us-west-2 we saw p95 latency return to ~220–280ms and 5xx counts dropped to near-zero within 14 minutes of the full ramp. Our product team reported no session ordering issues during the window and checkout conversion recovered.

We appreciate the transparency and the on-call responsiveness. Please include the full post-mortem and the kernel/kv findings you mentioned; BrightScape would like a short summary for our internal incident log. We may request a small one-time credit against Sept usage — I’ll open a formal request through your support portal.

—Claire
